quantisation_note: INT8 post-training quantisation cost 10.5 accuracy points on this backbone (88.2 -> 77.8) with no speedup, so float32 ships. EfficientNet quantises poorly: per-channel range spread in depthwise convolutions plus squeeze-excitation blocks.
hidden_note: Classes suppressed at inference: their logit is set to -inf before softmax, so probability redistributes across the rest. The model still has the weights; this is a display decision, not a retrain.
